title: Lunar Crustal Magnetic Field Heterogeneity and Implications for Biological Systems at Candidate Landing Sites
description: Analysis pipeline, publication-quality figures, and interactive visualization for lunar crustal magnetic field data from NASA PDS (Lunar Prospector and SELENE/Kaguya missions). Includes a systematic review of hypomagnetic field effects on terrestrial biology and a risk assessment framework for biological systems at candidate lunar landing sites including Artemis III regions.
notes: This software accompanies a manuscript submitted to a Nature Publishing Group journal. All data sourced from NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) under US Public Domain license.
